summary: The 25-episode 2008 anime adapts manga ACT.001-066 (volumes 1-11) with one clean omission: Kanae's arc (chs 46-50, the Kanae/Hiou conflict) is skipped entirely — ep 19 ends at ch 45 and ep 20 jumps to ch 51 (using only its Ren/Lory thread), with Hiou appearing solely as a teaser cameo in ep 25's closing. Episode boundaries were derived by cross-matching fandom arc pages (which carry explicit chapter+episode lists per arc), fandom episode/chapter plot summaries, and Wikipedia's chapter list (episode titles equal chapter titles for 21 of 25 episodes — strong independent title-alignment). Notable structure: ch 1 is a double-length debut chapter adapted alone in ep 1; the entire Bo's arc (chs 20-24) is compressed into ep 11; episode boundaries sometimes cross fandom's arc-level groupings (ep 5 ends at ch 9, ep 17 opens at ch 37). Existing anchor ep25→66 v11 confirmed by independent continue-reading sources (resume at ch 67 / vol 12). Chapter space is tankōbon ACT numbering and matches the context file's volume boundaries exactly (verified against Wikipedia vols 1-12); no conversion needed.

structure.notes: Single 25-episode season (AniList 4722), fully canon. Adapts ACT.001-066 = tankōbon vols 1-11 minus chs 46-50, ending mid-Dark Moon arc; continue reading at ch 67 (vol 12). Episode titles equal chapter titles for 21/25 episodes (Wikipedia episode list vs Wikipedia chapter list) — used as independent corroboration of fandom's per-arc chapter+episode groupings. Chapter space is mainline ACT numbering; volume extras ('A Scary True Story...', 'A Bit of a Leftover Story') are unnumbered omake and unadapted. Context file volume boundaries match Wikipedia's tankōbon lists exactly for v1-v12. Fandom arc-page episode groupings are arc-level only — actual episode boundaries cross them at ep 5 (ends ch 9) and ep 17 (starts ch 37).
